title: ni-slab-edu: Slab model with two-dimensional full horizontal velocity-gradient tensor
description: Educational Python for a slab mixed-layer model with a two-dimensional full horizontal velocity-gradient tensor. Implements the transfer function H (equations 12-16) and Green function G (equations 17-22) of Kim (ORNI manuscript), and redraws manuscript Figures 2 and 3. Controls check G against scipy.linalg.expm and H against the isotropic slab.
